description: Ladder extension of hou_early_time_v1: replicate 129x256 under the identical protocol and extend to 257x512, to test whether the T_1 amplification trend continues toward the published 1536^2 value 20.5235 without grid-scale saturation
interpretation: This is a resolution-limited numerical observation. It is not a reproduction of any published amplification value, not a singularity candidate, and not a proof.
coordinate_system: axisymmetric cylindrical half-plane (r,z), r in [0,1], z periodic with period 1
normalization_description: Hou finite-cylinder normalization: u1 = u^theta/r, omega1 = omega^theta/r, psi1 = psi^theta/r; the E-29 amplitude 12000 is part of the audited equation and is multiplied by amplitude_scale, which exists only so that reduced-amplitude smoke runs can reuse this schema

units.energy: dimensionless kinetic energy on the finite cylinder
